subject: E-5144: token rejected on Android
body:
Good morning. My setup is CourierOS 3.5.1, Android 14 (Glaxy S23). Since yesterday, every time I open the app, I get "E-5144: authentication token rejected".

This month the organisation moved everyone to single sign-on. Logging in on the website works, the app does not.

What I tried so far: rebooting the rouuter. No luck.

Mei Lin - Brightwater Clinics. Appreciate any pointers.
